description: This file contains unit tests for the channel policy functions related to security configurations, warning collectors, and handling of allowlist entries within a chat or messaging application, implemented using Vitest testing framework.

methods.name: createRestrictSendersChannelSecurity
methods.description: Creates a security configuration object for restricting senders on a channel with support for resolving policies and allowances dynamically.

methods.name: createDangerousNameMatchingMutableAllowlistWarningCollector
methods.description: Generates a warning collector function that detects mutable allowlist entries and optionally skips warnings if dangerous name matching is explicitly allowed.
